description:
Taak-Ri, an abandoned village that no one visits because of ghosts...

The Mystery X-Files production team takes interest and visits the place. However, what awaits them are ghosts that died in the incident at the time, and Nam Do-Cheol, who has become a living evil spirit through an evil spell called Yeommae. The reporting team that saw them tries to leave the village in a hurry, but Nam Do-Cheol has no intention of letting the reporting team go kindly. The reporting team tries to run away, and Nam Do-Cheol and Cheong-Song try to catch them!! And the truth from 50 years ago is revealed!

(Source: Naver, translated)
